ns2:section.sectionText: Vehicle time will be in person, please see syllabus or speak with your professor about regular meetings for this course. Graduate and undergraduate student content will be delivered online synchronously. Graduate and undergraduate students interested in taking CS 598 MAV /MAE need to attend the first class. This includes ECE students interested in the course. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC, or MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC.
